summary: Gives guidelines for end-to-end quality of service in a Proxy Mobile IPv6 domain whose access network uses IEEE 802.11. It describes mapping the QoS negotiated between MAG and LMA, per RFC 7222, to Wi-Fi mechanisms.

eli5.summary: A guide to translating priority rules between two systems, so a video call on Wi-Fi keeps its fast lane while moving around a network.

questions: proxy mobile ipv6 quality of service
